ticket.title: Improve the Workspace2 unsaved-changes confirmation modal
ticket.text:
Improve the Workspace2 unsaved-changes confirmation modal

The current Workspace2 confirmation modal uses ambiguous copy:

- "Close workspace(s)"
- "You are about to close the following workspace(s), which might have unsaved changes:"
- "Cancel"

The modal only appears when affected workspaces have reported unsaved changes, so "might" is inaccurate. Parenthesized pluralization is difficult to scan, and "Cancel" does not clearly communicate whether it cancels closing the workspace or the user's work.

Update the modal to describe the consequences clearly, distinguish singular and multiple-workspace cases, and emphasize the affected workspace titles.

## Proposed copy

Shared title

Discard unsaved changes?

Single workspace

Add drug order has unsaved changes. Closing it will discard them.

Actions:

- Keep editing
- Discard changes

Multiple workspaces

3 workspaces have unsaved changes. Closing them will discard the changes:

- Add drug order
- Visit note
- Record vitals

Actions:

- Keep editing
- Discard changes

## Acceptance criteria

- The modal title is "Discard unsaved changes?"
- "Keep editing" replaces "Cancel".
- "Discard changes" remains the destructive action.
- The header close button and "Keep editing" both dismiss the modal without closing any workspace.
- Selecting “Discard changes” confirms the close and allows the originally requested close operation to continue.
- Singular copy is displayed when one workspace is affected.
- Multiple-workspace copy begins with the affected workspace count.
- Singular and multiple variants use distinct translation keys with interpolated values.
- Parenthesised forms such as "workspace(s)" are not used.
- The affected workspace title is emphasised in the singular variant.
- All affected workspace titles are emphasised and presented as a list in the multiple-workspace variant.
- The modal uses the small Carbon modal size.
- Existing behaviour that skips the prompt when no affected workspace has unsaved changes is preserved.
- Automated tests cover singular and multiple rendering, cancellation, confirmation, and the header close action.
- New copy is added to both the core translation definitions and the English source translations.
- The superseded `closeWorkspaces2PromptTitle` and `closeWorkspaces2PromptBody` translation keys are removed.

understanding.intent: Update the Workspace2 unsaved-changes confirmation modal copy and layout to clearly distinguish between single and multiple workspaces and clarify the action buttons.
